### A Soul Poured Out
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/a-soul-poured-out-girlfriends-in-god-june-21-2013.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 1:15
Points:
- In deep and prolonged sorrow, believers should acknowledge their pain honestly instead of pretending everything is fine.
- Rather than venting to others first, Hannah took her distress directly to God and poured out her entire heart.
- Hannah spent earnest, unhurried time before the Lord instead of offering brief, casual requests.
- Pouring out one's grief in God's presence replaces emptiness and despair with divine peace, lifting a downcast countenance even before circumstances change.

### The Weight of Grief
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-14-2023.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 1:10-11, 18
Points:
- When confronted with painful trials and provocation, Hannah chose to seek God rather than harbor resentment or pursue retaliation.
- Hannah approached God acknowledging His majesty and sovereignty as His servant, rather than trying to manipulate Him with a bargain.
- Her appetite returned and sadness lifted simply because she cast her anxieties on the Lord, well before knowing how He would answer.
- Believers facing grief can boldly bring their cries into God's presence through Christ, finding settled peace in His goodness.
